entries.source: Collection Methods & Legal Grounds / Toplama Yöntemi ve Hukuki Sebepler
entries.translation: Collection Methods & Legal Grounds / Toplama Yöntemi ve Hukuki Sebepler

entries.source: Personal data may be collected electronically or verbally through website forms, Trip Planner, WhatsApp, telephone, e-mail, electronic-ticket and booking-management processes, browser storage used for requested site functions, optional browser geolocation after the visitor grants permission, and confirmations exchanged with the relevant service provider.

entries.source: Depending on the processing activity, ordinary personal data is processed on one or more legal grounds provided by KVKK, including that processing is necessary for the establishment or performance of a contract, compliance with a legal obligation, establishment/exercise/protection of a right, or the legitimate interests of the data controller provided that the fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject are not harmed.

entries.source: Personal data may be shared, only to the extent necessary for the stated purposes, with the relevant tour operator, transfer or activity provider, accommodation/pickup contact where operationally required, accounting/legal advisers, authorised information-technology, hosting or database service providers, and legally authorised public authorities.

entries.source: Retention / Saklama

entries.source: Personal data is kept only for the period necessary for the relevant booking/service purpose and for any applicable statutory retention, accounting, claim or limitation periods. When the purpose and legal retention requirement end, data is deleted, destroyed or anonymised in accordance with applicable law and the controller’s retention practices.
